uri.description: Link to the phenotype term's page on the IGVF portal.

term_id.description: Ontology identifier for the screened phenotype, with the prefix separated by an underscore rather than a colon. These are NTR terms: phenotypes the portal describes with a new-term request because no existing ontology term covers them, which is why this adapter loads them rather than the standard ontology adapter.

synonyms.description: Synonyms for the term that have been recorded in an ontology. Null for NTR terms, which have none.

class.description: The class of the ontology term, from the associated files_filesets record

method.description: The method of the ontology term, from the associated files_filesets record

files_filesets.description: The files filesets of the ontology term. Null because the NTR phenotype term is shared vocabulary, not tied to a single dataset. See DSERV-1466.
